title: The Five-Step Process, Step 1: Setting Big and Audacious Goals
summary: Acknowledging an extension of the government quarantine, President Hughes addresses the ongoing struggle to control the mind and exercise agency correctly. He introduces a five-step process for managing agency and achieving potential, detailing Step 1: setting large, important, and audacious goals by prioritizing effectively, distinguishing goals from mere desires, remaining flexible, and maintaining self-accountability.
